comment: Independent artifact.c retouch_equipment() reached from a monster's turn. A debug-mode lawful Valkyrie wishes for a blessed silver saber, wields it, creates a hostile werejackal and waits with m-prefixed searches, ESC dismissing each --More-- and answering no to each 'Die?'. When the jackal-form bite gives lycanthropy, uhitm.c mhitm_ad_were() calls retouch_equipment(2): the saber now burns a silver-hater, 'You can't handle your silver saber anymore!' follows 'You feel feverish.', and the saber falls to the stairs. The elapsed-turn planning clone stops at that call, so the live pass prints it in source order.
